test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c13f197f67028ec336ee7df5b8996f7ac3129d0623b1c649a97d89164a9fe8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The 'Shaded Circle' is getting rotated in anti-clockwise direction and shifting its place by +1, +2,+3,+4,+5 places.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e66fafe289e8ef082daee3a4859fb73bab22b422405f6fca23bf0c4508c0de7d.png] 

Step II: The 'Letter A' is getting rotated in anti-clockwise direction and shifting its place by +1, +2,+3,+4,+5 places.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0825078444263bee88aa017484096f7cdd312698507cc5015305b3bea57cb492.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68d3102e7f0c53574c2b201c77761ee9ea391a52c7fb78b48a70a4b4b577c056.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
